el.¿Qué es el Posgrado en Yoga Esencial?: What is the Postgraduate Program in Essential Yoga?
el.Son tres meses de formación avanzada, on: It's three months of advanced training, online and live, focused on three tools for teaching: Chair Yoga, Yoga Nidra and creative visualizations.
el.¿Puedo hacer el Posgrado sin haber hecho: Can I take the Postgraduate Program without having done the Teacher Training?
el.Sí, si ya tenés una formación previa en: Yes, as long as you already have previous yoga training or are already teaching. If you're coming from the Teacher Training, it's the natural next step: same day, same time and same group.
el.De septiembre a noviembre de 2027, los m: From September to November 2027, on Tuesdays from 19 to 21 hs, Argentina time. One theme per month.
el.¿Cuánto sale el Posgrado?: How much does the Postgraduate Program cost?
el.Un pago de $395.000 o tres cuotas de $14: One payment of $395.000 or three installments of $143.000.
el.¿Puedo cursar un solo módulo?: Can I take just one module?
